    RECV_METHOD_LINE = 5

    RECV_HEADERS = 7
    RECV_BODY = 8
    DONE = 9
    CLOSED = 10


class Mode(enum.Enum):
    CLIENT = 0
    SERVER = 1

            self.recv_state: State = State.WAIT

        Sending state will switch to SEND_HEADERS state.
